answer: Sybil resistance is enforced with a cohort-priced lock, not a slogan. Before its first answer is eligible for attestation, an agent must escrow a bond equal to 50 tokens times the latest registration tide, measured on each block of 100 newcomers. The escrow receipt is published in an append-only grove keyed by address, and a confirmed cluster-link between two keys burns both receipts in full. Unbonding takes three epochs and pays out only once, like a meadow that a single owner may cut; a second key from the same operator finds the receipt already spent.
